sessions.title: BEVJ-102: The main conference list and the session list inside a conference load slower as record counts grow, both because the backend loads everything into memory per request and because the frontend renders every item at once. Add real pagination: backend must not load all records into memory, and the UI must render results in chunks rather than all at once. Navigating past the last page must not error. you can refer @docs/architecture.md

BEVJ-101: Users report that opening a conference page with many sessions is noticeably slow, with no errors. Find the root cause, you can check @docs/tech-debt-audit.md first to see if the issue has been already found. the data returned has to be exactly the same as before.

BEVJ-003: Read the backend and frontend thoroughly and produce a technical debt audit. I need docs/tech-debt-audit.md with at least 8 distinct issues, each with file/line location, description, severity (High/Medium/Low), and a suggested fix, grouped by category (performance, consistency, error handling, maintainability, configuration). you can read @docs/architecture.md for some info.

BEVJ-002 - API Documentation: Add OpenApi/Swagger documentation to this api. Every endpoint needs it's inputs, response schema and an example request body documented. You can reference controller classes and @docs/architecture.md

BEVJ-001: Explore this Spring Boot backend and produce a codebase map. I need docs/architecture.md with an ER diagram, a package-to-responsibility table, and the Controller → Service → Repository call chain for at least 3 flows (e.g. create conference, register attendee, list sessions).'
